curriculum.name: replace_visit_location
curriculum.goal: Given a place, move the most recent visit to that place and return the visit.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE replace_visit_location(place:PLACE)
$v0 = FIND_LAST VISIT
UPDATE $v0 WHERE={place}
RETURN $v0
END
